verdict.rationale: Airwallex Billing documents its own subscription management, including multi-item and multi-frequency recurring charges and recurring invoices, so recurring billing with product and pricing structures is covered. The evidence never mentions free trials, plan upgrades or downgrades, or proration, which are a large part of the story. Missing for 10: documented trial periods, upgrade/downgrade flows, proration logic, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Multi-item: Billing for multiple products in one place, for example, a software license plus a support package.
Multi-frequency: Charging for different items on different schedules, for example, an annual upfront software fee combined with monthly support fees.
Airwallex Billing layers subscriptions, invoicing, and hosted/embedded billing checkout on top of payments acceptance
